ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure; on the left there is an oxygen-containing three-membered ring/epoxide-like fragment, bearing an R1 substituent; this fragment is connected to the central carbon through the carbon on the right. The central carbon is connected to R2, OH, and NH substituents; NH is further connected to NH2. There are also curved arrows and an arrow pointing to H+ in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows, and bonds involving hydrogen are not counted. Reasoning: Count one by one according to the bonds between heavy atoms/R groups, and count each only once. The left fragment includes R1–C, C–O, epoxide top C–C, O–C wedge bond, and the bond from the right epoxide carbon to the central carbon, for a total of 5. Around the central carbon there are also C–R2, C–O(OH), and C–N(NH), for a total of 3. In the hydrazine-like substituent there is 1 N–N(NH–NH2) bond. The total is 5 + 3 + 1 = 9.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Trace the heavy-atom/R-group bonds visually and tally them once: in the left fragment count R1–C, C–O, C–C across the epoxide top edge, O–C wedge bond, and the bond from the right epoxide carbon to the central carbon (5). Around the central carbon count C–R2, C–O of OH, and C–N of NH (3). In the hydrazine substituent count N–N to NH2 (1). Add 5 + 3 + 1 = 9.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧有一个含氧三元环/环氧样片段，带有 R1 取代基；该片段通过右侧碳连接到中心碳。中心碳连有 R2、OH 和 NH 取代基；NH 进一步与 NH2 相连。图中还有弯箭头和指向 H+ 的箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头，并且不计涉及氢的键。
推理：按重原子/R 基团之间的键逐一计数且每条只数一次。左侧片段包括 R1–C、C–O、环氧顶部 C–C、O–C 楔形键、右侧环氧碳到中心碳的键，共 5 条。中心碳周围还有 C–R2、C–O(OH)、C–N(NH)，共 3 条。肼样取代基中有 N–N(NH–NH2) 1 条。总数为 5 + 3 + 1 = 9。

method.method_draft: Assign non-H degrees from the image: R1 has degree 1; the left epoxide carbon has degree 3 (to R1, O, and the other epoxide carbon); the epoxide O has degree 2; the right epoxide carbon has degree 3 (to left carbon, O, and central carbon); the central carbon has degree 4 (to right epoxide carbon, R2, OH oxygen, and NH nitrogen); R2 has degree 1; the OH oxygen has degree 1; the internal NH nitrogen has degree 2 (to central carbon and terminal nitrogen); the terminal NH2 nitrogen has degree 1.
